mapper.select: SELECT id, entity_type, action_type, entity_id, before_snapshot, after_snapshot, summary, status, requested_by, requested_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM audit_request WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_request (entity_type, action_type, entity_id, before_snapshot, after_snapshot, summary, status, requested_by, requested_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{entityType}, #{actionType}, #{entityId}, #{beforeSnapshot}, #{afterSnapshot}, #{summary}, #{status}, #{requestedBy}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_request SET entity_id = #{entityId}, status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
